components.title: Domain
components.purpose: The rules of the game with no Unity in it: items, rounds, schedule, progress, school check, parent gate, phrase catalog.

components.title: Storage
components.purpose: Everything written to or read from disk: profiles, settings, answer log, check log, phrase file.

components.title: Presentation
components.purpose: The screens, drawing, number pad and voice player; AppRoot wires the app and decides which screen leads to which.

components.title: Voice
components.purpose: The spoken clips, the generated VoiceLibrary asset that maps a clip name to its clip, and VoiceScript.csv for the recorder.

components.title: Text
components.purpose: Hr.json: the Croatian text and spoken clip names of every phrase, loose beside the player.

components.title: Editor (BuildScript)
components.purpose: BuildScript.Build for the batch build, and VoiceLibraryBuilder, which regenerates the voice library and script.

components.title: EditMode tests
components.purpose: NUnit EditMode tests of Domain and Storage, with in-memory test doubles.
